description: Every payload member of every claim type this format registers, and what a verifier holds it against. A profile whose link or leaf commits the whole claim, loomseal-chain-v1 or loomseal-merkle-v1, commits every member. switchtender-audit-v1 commits only its bound members. Under it, every other member a claim carries is disclosed beside the link: checked against the commitment named here, redacted, or unchecked for the reason given. A member named nowhere here is unchecked. Names are compared exactly, so a name that differs from a declared one only in case is another member, and a claim whose check reads the declared member fails when it carries one. Both verifiers in this repository read this file, and the conformance vectors are generated from it.

records.description: A switchtender.audit/1 claim is a record by the method and path its link commits, and only a record's own members are read on it. A record member on any other claim is an ordinary member, which nothing commits. Paths are compared segment by segment, and a {name} segment matches any non-empty segment.
records.elsewhere: the claim is not a record that carries it, so nothing commits it
records.legacy: the entry's content_digest in the legacy unkeyed form, which anyone who can guess the body can confirm

refused._sd: selective disclosure needs a profile whose link or leaf commits the whole claim

reason_text.by: the reason_commitment its record body carries

reason_random.by: the reason_commitment its record body carries

reason_redacted.by: a privacy redaction removed the reason's text and random value and kept its commitment

spec_body.by: the spec_digest a verified decision or outcome names
spec_body.unchecked: no verified decision or outcome names a spec digest

outcome_body.by: the entry's content_digest in the exact form
outcome_body.unchecked: the entry committed it under an older digest form, over the producer's own redaction

outcome_nonce.by: the entry's content_digest in the exact form
